text:
Hang all fourteen shards. The ring knows its own law.

The hasp — your hoard, one shard off every lock you opened

All fourteen sockets hang full. Close the ring.

Take the ring apart
Close the ring

Tap a shard, then a socket — or drag it there. The iron rivet is slot 0; the ring runs sunwise from it.
